subject: Daz
fact: Daz could talk to the beasts.
source_quote: turned out he could talk to the beasts

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir was the stealthiest of us.
source_quote: Zalthir to the rooms, stealthiest of us

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool had learned silence.
source_quote: Glabbagool announced it had learned silence

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool asked whether the silence was good or too loud.
source_quote: asked whether that was good silence or too loud silence

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool tried to grow a nose to smell the poison.
source_quote: tried to grow a nose to smell the poison

subject: Daral
fact: Daral was the one who gave the poisoned book to Janussi.
source_quote: poisoned by a book Daral had given him

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was drow and knew that world the way Zalthir knew a tunnel's slope.
source_quote: Daz was drow. Daz knew that world the way I know a tunnel's slope without thinking about it

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said he could read next to nothing off the object at a glance.
source_quote: What I can read off it at a glance is next to nothing

subject: Daral
fact: Daral filled the room the way a leak fills a hold.
source_quote: Daral was a person who had not learned that lesson. He filled the room the way a leak fills a hold

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir took to standing near the doorways.
source_quote: I had taken to standing near the doorways

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir watched Glabbagool go quiet and marked it.
source_quote: I watched him go quiet. I marked it and said nothing

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool's instinct, every time, is still to reach toward the problem.
source_quote: his instinct, every time, is still to reach toward the problem

subject: Daz
fact: Daz muttered that he couldn't take the object apart to study it proper.
source_quote: Too bad I can't really take it apart... Turn it over, study it proper

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said the murder at least had a structure.
source_quote: I turned to the murder, because the murder at least had a structure

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir noted that Janussi was dead, poisoned by a book Daral had given him.
source_quote: Janussi was dead. Poisoned by a book Daral had given him

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said the whole thing was so ornate that it itched.
source_quote: And the whole thing was so ornate that it itched

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked who would want to frame Daral and kill Janussi.
source_quote: who would want to frame you and kill — whatever the guy is?

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said the question worth holding was the double stroke.
source_quote: That was the question worth holding. Not the death. The double stroke.

subject: A'lai Aivenmore
fact: A'lai Aivenmore wanted the keep and saw Daral's love of poetry as a threat.
source_quote: A'lai Aivenmore. The one who wanted the keep. The one about to be dismissed. The one who saw Daral's love of poetry, his love of fiction, as a threat to his approach to the universe.

subject: Daral
fact: Daral said framing him made perfect sense to clear the deck of Janussi and himself.
source_quote: Clear the deck of Janussi. Clear the wood of me. No one left on the council able to prevent his ascension.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir filed the name A'lai.
source_quote: I filed the name. A'lai.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked Glabbagool to try to grow a nose and smell the poison.
source_quote: can Glabbagool try to grow a nose and get a good smell of the poison?

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool's eye rose again, eager, to try to grow a nose.
source_quote: The eye rose again, eager. He'd try. He always tries.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed the dining hall still smelled like breakfast.
source_quote: The dining hall still smelled like breakfast.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin saw Milil's statue with a brass chalice resting in open hands.
source_quote: Milil stood in an alcove off to one side, the god of bards: open hands, a brass chalice resting in them like an offering nobody had come to collect.

subject: Daral
fact: Daral remembered the Milil chalice was lead-lined.
source_quote: the Milil chalice is lead-lined

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin took the chalice down from the statue's hands.
source_quote: I went to the altar, took the chalice down out of those open hands

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin saw a heart and a blood-stained meat cleaver in the chalice.
source_quote: A heart. And a blood-stained meat cleaver.

subject: Daral
fact: Daral said the heart was Janussi's.
source_quote: Janussi's heart

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said he left the heart in Waterdeep.
source_quote: I left it in Waterdeep.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said the cleaver bothered him more than the heart.
source_quote: The cleaver bothered me more than the heart, honestly.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said whoever did this knew the chalice was lead-lined.
source_quote: whoever did this knew the chalice was lead-lined. Knew it would hide a body part from every far-seeing working the keep could throw at it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said the killer was someone who knew the ins and outs of the keep.
source_quote: Somebody who'd planned a murder around Candlekeep's own hoard of magic.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said the person who handled the chalice late was a witness and a window.
source_quote: You just have to find the person who saw it.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin noticed three junior avowed watching him before he spoke.
source_quote: I noticed the three of them watching before I'd said a word.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said she really hates it when people make the joke about her name.
source_quote: I, you know, I really hate it when people make that joke.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony has a compulsive need to always tell the truth.
source_quote: this compulsive need to always tell the truth

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said the Deadwinter supper began at the 5PM bell.
source_quote: The Deadwinter supper began at the 5PM bell.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said everyone at the table was tense and taciturn except Alkrist.
source_quote: Everybody at the table was tense and taciturn, she said, except Alkrist.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said Alkrist was pitching a project: Tales of War by the Generals That Waged Them.
source_quote: pitching a project: Tales of War by the Generals That Waged Them

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said Janussi praised Alkrist's project as knowledge that could benefit civilization.
source_quote: Janussi praised it the other way: 'the kind of knowledge that could benefit civilization'

subject: Daral
fact: Daral muttered under his breath: 'Oh, you've been right behind one of us all night.'
source_quote: Daral muttered under his breath, 'Oh, you've been right behind one of us all night.'

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said Sylvira Savikas stormed out.
source_quote: Then Sylvira Savikas stormed out

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said Kazryn Nyantani handed out gifts under the evergreen tree.
source_quote: Kazryn Nyantani took it on herself to hand out the gifts under the evergreen tree

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said Janussi took his gift unwrapped and dropped the wrapping paper in a wicker basket.
source_quote: Janussi took his unwrapped, thanked his secret donor, and excused himself, dropping the wrapping paper in a wicker basket by the door on his way out.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said nobody was sick from eating the leftovers.
source_quote: Nobody sick, Irony said.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said the wrapping paper turned up in Janussi's office, not here.
source_quote: The wrapping paper turned up in Janussi's office, not here.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony said Sprig tasted all the food.
source_quote: Sprig tasted all the food.

subject: Irony
fact: Irony confirmed Sprig was the poison taster.
source_quote: Is she the poison taster?" I asked, and Irony said yes
